posts.text:
The war in Ukraine has now lasted 1,569 days, surpassing the length of World War I.

Every day this war continues is another day thousands of Ukrainian children abducted by Russia remain separated from their families. We cannot stop working to bring them home.

Inflation is rising, and Trump “loves it.”

Well Minnesotans don’t “love it.” And as Governor, I’ll focus on lowering costs. That’s the job.


Acyn (@Acyn)

Reporter: Are you concerned, Mr. President, about the latest inflation number which came out this morning?

Trump: No, I love it. I love the inflation.

posts.text:
Making life more affordable for Minnesotans starts with making housing more affordable.

That’s why I’m committed to putting Minnesota on a path to build 100,000 homes and lower housing costs for Minnesota families.
posts.quote:
Making life more affordable for Minnesotans starts with making housing more affordable.

posts.text:
As former Mayor of Fergus Falls, my running mate Ben Schierer knows that housing and economic growth go hand in hand.

If workers can't find a place to live, businesses can't grow. Our plan will build more homes, lower costs, and create more opportunities across Minnesota.


benjamin schierer (@benschierer)

When businesses can't find workers and families have nowhere to put down roots — that's a housing problem and an economic problem. Amy’s and my housing affordability plan addresses both.
